A complete, free, open-source companion for every Muslim — prayer times, Adhan, Quran, hadith, adhkar and more, in your language.

Muslim is a free and open-source Android app that accompanies you throughout the day: astronomically accurate prayer times with the Adhan, a precise Qibla compass, the complete Quran with recitations and tafsir, a hadith library, sourced adhkar, an electronic tasbih, Ramadan tools, a zakat calculator, offline maps, and more — designed to work fully offline with privacy by default.
Everything a Muslim needs in one app:
Prayer times & Adhan — all calculation methods, juristic schools, and 18+ adhan sounds
Complete Quran — Uthmani script, 44 reciters, tafsir, translations, word search & frequency
Adhkar, tasbih, Ramadan & Zakat — with reminders and floating bubbles
Offline-first — maps, Quran, hadith and adhkar work with no internet
Privacy by default — no ads, no tracking, your data stays on your device
Muslim is a completely free, open-source app under the GPLv3 license — no ads, no subscriptions, no tracking. Any modified version stays open source.
Free forever · Privacy first · Astronomical accuracy in prayer times and qibla · Works offline · Support for juristic schools through customizable settings.
Quran, hadith and adhkar texts undergo specialist religious review, separate from code review, before the official release. Quran text source: Tanzil project (Uthmani script).

Muslim respects your privacy and does not collect your data.

• No tracking: no ad SDKs, analytics or marketing trackers.
• Data stays on your device: all your data (location, settings, bookmarks) is stored locally on your device only.
• Location is used locally: your coordinates are used to calculate prayer times and the qibla on your device, and are never sent to any external server.
• Permissions only when needed: we ask for permissions (location, notifications) only when a feature actually needs them, with a clear explanation.
• No forced connectivity: the app works offline; network use is entirely optional for extras such as downloading recitations.

This policy is part of the open-source repository and is open to community review.

Customisable options for accessing content and navigating the app. Use them alongside TalkBack and your device display settings.
Each new interactive element has a clear name, and controls announce their state and action. Turn on TalkBack in Android Accessibility settings, then use normal focus and swipe navigation.
Use the bundled Noto Sans Arabic typeface and wider line spacing for Quran and adhkar text. This option preserves the text and is not a medical treatment for dyslexia.
Use clear black-and-white colours instead of dynamic wallpaper colours to distinguish text and controls.

Android Auto, Wear OS, and an optional home-adhan bridge
Sync the next prayer and tasbih counter with your paired watch. Sync does not send location or account settings.
Only fully downloaded surahs appear in the safe media interface. The app never starts downloads or shows video while driving.
Sends a short event after local audible adhan playback begins to an HTTPS endpoint you choose. Your home service can connect that event to Google Home, Alexa, or another automation you control.
Nothing is sent by default. When enabled, the app sends only the prayer name and event time; it never sends location, audio, or app settings. The token is stored locally with Android Keystore.
Use a complete HTTPS address. Your service must validate the token and decide how to trigger home playback.
